t: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–317, $4,000,000 are rescinded.

fable.w: This provision only rescinds previously appropriated funds. There is no tempting contrary reading: it involves no consultation, hearing, comment period, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
fable.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–317, $4,000,000 are rescinded.

opus.w: This is a plain funding rescission that cancels $4,000,000 of earlier appropriations. It sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body or right to sue, so no one outside the federal government takes part in any decision. Calling it participation just because it is a federal action fails, because participation requires an outside party in the decision process.
opus.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–317, $4,000,000 are rescinded.
opus.b: I think a few might be tempted to read a rescission of funds as a federal decision that could involve outside input, but that reading doesn't hold up. This section only cancels $4,000,000 of previously appropriated funds. It names no process and no outside party: no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body or right to sue.

qwen_chat.w: This section simply rescinds a specific amount of appropriated funds. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government (such as states, tribes, the public, or private entities). It is a unilateral budgetary action by Congress.
qwen_chat.s: Of the funds made available under this heading in Public Law 103–317, $4,000,000 are rescinded.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that rescinding funds is a "decision" and therefore any process leading to it involves participation. However, the text itself contains no mention of any process, consultation, hearing, or interaction with outside parties. It is a unilateral legislative action regarding budget numbers.
